# @aponiajs/view

> Laravel-style Blade view rendering for AponiaJS, with layouts, sections, components, slots, props, and dot-notation lookup.

## Exports

- `ViewModule.register({ defaultEngine: "blade" | "html", rootDir?, shared?, engine?, cache? })`
- `ViewService`: `render(template, data, options?)` and `share(key, value)`
- `BladeViewEngine`: `@extends`, `@section`, `@yield`, `@include`, `<x-component>`, `{{ }}`, `{!! !!}`, `@if`, `@foreach`
- `HtmlViewEngine`: zero-dependency token substitution
- `VIEW_ENGINE`: the injection token from `@aponiajs/common`
- Types: `ViewEngine`, `ViewModuleOptions`, `BladeViewEngineOptions`
